title: Bio 101: Why you exist
subtitle: and why your dad picked your gender
scriptText: Alright. Apparently we need to explain how boys and girls are made. Buckle up. Every human has twenty-three pairs of chromosomes. Wow. Math. I know. ONE pair decides if you're male or female. One. Pair. Girls have two X chromosomes. X-X. Easy. Boys have one X and one Y. X-Y. Genius. The mom always gives an X. She literally has no other option. Which means the DAD decides the gender. Yeah. Tell your mom she's been blaming the wrong person all these years. So that's it. That's the whole thing. And you didn't know this. Ha ha ha. Imagine.
